stem: Meera packs her lunch for school on a hot summer afternoon. Which lunch choice best supports healthy eating?

options.text: A large plate of fried chips, because they taste good and are familiar
A moderate portion of fresh roti, dal, and seasonal cucumber salad, eaten calmly at lunchtime
A very large serving of fresh fruit, eaten late at night just before sleeping
A brightly coloured packet of sweets, because the wrapper looks attractive

teacher.key_rationale: B satisfies all three checks: wholesome food, moderate quantity, and suitability to season, time, and place. A relies on familiarity/taste, C ignores quantity and timing despite wholesome food, D relies on appearance.
